text:
maria: heads up — telemetry ingestion errors started ~10m ago, alerting on batch writer 5xxs and retries. looks correlated with the v2.3.1 rollout to eu1. impact: degraded metrics pipeline and higher customer-visible processing latency.
sam: can we do a hotpatch? this is customer-impacting, want to fast-track. change window is small (30m) so prefer skip long canary if we have approvals.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created by @maria: redwood-release/hotfix/telemetry-backpressure -> env=eu1, image=serve:2026-03-20-hotfix. approvals_required: [release-manager].
maria: patch = revert of partial KV cache optimization (commit abc123). tiny change, no schema or DB migration. smoke passed on staging.
anya: infra signoff +1 — ran smoke and load-lite, no obvious regression. I can be on-call for rollback.
leo: release-manager here. need rollback criteria before I approve skip canary. what are the clear stop/rollback signals?
maria: rollback if: 1) 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2 minutes, OR 2) p95 latency increases > 150ms vs baseline, OR 3) healthcheck non-200 for >60s. I'll be watching dashboards.
sam: I approve expedited deploy for eu1 hotfix. also recommend pinning Dedicated model to avoid fallback differences during the window.
release-manager: approving expedite deploy. canary skipped per request, change window 15:05-15:35 UTC. tagging owners: @maria @anya @sam.
deploy-bot: ACTION: starting deploy to eu1. command: ```kubectl -n prod set image deployment/telemetry-service telemetry=serve:2026-03-20-hotfix --record```
ci-bot: Canary skip recorded. snapshot created for quick rollback: s3://redwood-backups/telemetry/2026-03-20-1819004300.tar.gz
maria: observing metrics in real time — error rate dropping from 2.1% -> 0.15% so far, p95 stable.
anya: double-checking logs, no increase in transient connection errors. :thumbsup:
leo: pinning Dedicated pool model to stable: ```model.pin --region eu1 --model serve-v1.12 --until 2026-03-25``` done. prevents automatic variant routing during incident.
sam: noted for release notes and postmortem action item to validate KV cache change more in staging load.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded, new revision r789. rollout recorded and traffic at 100%.
maria: continuing to monitor for next 30m, will escalate if thresholds breach.
release-manager: thanks team. leaving this open for 35m then closing if stable. please add short blurb to release notes: "hotfix: revert KV cache optimization to mitigate telemetry ingestion errors in eu1, rolled out 2026-03-20."
ci-bot: post-deploy checklist completed: smoke ok, alerts silenced, snapshot available.
anya: filing follow-up ticket for improved staging load tests.
leo: +1 on closing once 30m stable.
maria: all good at 20m — error rate steady <0.2%, p95 within normal. closing prep. :white_check_mark:
